verdict.rationale: The docs describe stablecoin settlement end to end: a nine-step HTTP 402 handshake, the CDP Facilitator submitting settlement onchain, USDC/ERC-20/SPL support across Base, Polygon, Arbitrum, World and Solana, and agentic wallets that fund agent payments. Independent evidence backs this up: operators report running live x402 endpoints, a runtime probe found real USDC listings on Base, and the SDK is published with provenance. Missing for 10: no independent hands-on verification of an actual onchain settlement completing through the facilitator (the runtime probe only reached the auth-gated 401 endpoint and discovery listings).
